Calm: almost every warning light is off. The economy isn't showing the strains that have come before past downturns.
Elevated: a few warning lights are on — worth keeping an eye on, but most signs are still calm. Past recessions came with many lights on at once.
High: many warning lights are on at once, a pattern seen in the run-up to past downturns.
Severe: most warning lights are flashing, as they did in 2008 and 2020.
